Important: DetectionSummaryEvent is scheduled to be decommissioned September 30, 2025.
Falcon generates the DetectionSummaryEvent for many detections, particularly from desktop-based sensors. Not all Detection Summary events include all fields
listed in the table below.
Some Detection Summary events include multiple detections, when multiple malicious behaviors are detected. Each additional behavior will generate a separate
detection summary event with the same detection ID, and will have its own offset value.
